title: Editorial policy
html:
Editorial policy

Updated October 3, 2026

Useful content comes first

Our articles aim to answer a specific everyday question through explanations, examples, and practical steps. We do not copy third-party articles or present invented personal experience as reporting. AI assists the current writing; the publisher is responsible for reviewing material before relying on it or submitting the site for advertising review.

Accuracy and corrections

Prices, availability, travel conditions, and regulations change. We avoid unsupported claims about them and direct readers to check the relevant current source. When a material correction is made, the article’s updated date should reflect it. A public correction contact will be added when the publisher supplies their details.

Images and attribution

Current illustrations come from the design references supplied for this site. They are not presented as photographs taken by our writers or as evidence that a particular place exists. Publication rights for these images must be confirmed by the publisher before broader distribution or monetization.

Commercial relationships

No paid placements or affiliate links are currently included. If introduced later, sponsorships and affiliate relationships will be disclosed where readers encounter them. Advertising must remain visually distinguishable from editorial content.
